lede: The biggest item this week is Town Council's second reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code on Monday — this is the vote that would actually change Telluride's Land Use Code on landscaping, trees, and historic review to meet state wildfire standards, so it counts. The same day, the Housing Authority takes up a real policy question about primary residency rules for dependents of multiple custodial parents, and Wednesday's Planning and Zoning meeting puts three Town-owned development projects through formal subdivision and concept review in the Accommodations 2 zone.

notable.stake: Second-reading vote on wildfire code changes to Land Use Code landscaping and historic review.
New primary-residency policy for dependents of multiple custodial parents could reset eligibility rules.
Formal subdivision and concept review for three Town-owned development projects on Town land.
Public hearing on KOTO's special event liquor permit — residents may comment.
